open_questions.description: Repeatable mission reset confirmation: what does MissionSet_ActivateMission (0xd17c10) do with pre-existing child entries? Needs decompile.
MissionEntry +0x64 vs +0x100 status fields: two offsets receive same Status byte in HandleOnMissionUpdate. May be two distinct structs overlapping in decompiler view.
Hidden flag write offset in ObjectiveEntry: Hidden byte read from wire but no confirmed struct offset found.
FUN_00d205c0 role: triggered in HandleOnMissionUpdate when local_50 > 0. Likely mission data/PAK loading. Needs decompile.
ChosenRewards outbound path: SGWNetworkManager handler for Event_NetOut_ChosenRewards not traced. Client emit path undocumented.
BigWorldTimeComplete bool semantics in timer handler: timer expiry signal vs progress update?
FUN_00c6d1c0 role: called with (this+0x7C, duration, BigWorldTimeComplete) in timer handler. Timer UI object or server-time-sync?
Count INT32 vs INT8 wire mismatch: onTaskUpdate handler reads Count as INT32 (via 0xe3cba0) but alias.xml defines MissionTaskStatus.count as INT8. Verify Cimmeria serializer encoding.

key_findings.architecture: MissionSet singleton holds all client-side mission state. Server is authoritative; client is pure display layer. No client-authoritative mission logic in SGW.exe.
key_findings.status_values: Status 0=removed/failed, 1=active/accepted, 2=complete (2 inferred from token pattern, not explicitly confirmed in decompile).
key_findings.task_primitives_not_in_binary: KillCount, CollectItem, VisitRegion, TalkToNpc, UseObject, Timer strings NOT in SGW.exe. Server-side PAK data only. Client tracks Count+Status numerically.
key_findings.propagation_engine: MissionSet_PropagateMissionUpdate (0xd16dd0) is the cascade engine — called after every state change to walk task->objective->step->mission hierarchy.
key_findings.registration: All subscriptions installed at startup by RegisterBulkNetOutSignals (0xdb3390). Per-event wrapper: MissionSet_SubscribeOnMissionUpdate (0xdaa680).
key_findings.count_int32_vs_int8: POTENTIAL WIRE MISMATCH: onTaskUpdate reads Count as INT32 but alias.xml says INT8. Verify Cimmeria.
